description: This file defines the LDAPUserLookupSetting class, which encapsulates configuration settings for LDAP user lookup operations within the OrangeHRM system. It includes properties related to LDAP distinguished names, search scopes, attributes, filters, and mappings, along with methods to access, modify, serialize, and create instances of the class.

classes.name: LDAPUserLookupSetting
classes.description: A class representing the configuration settings for LDAP user lookups, including base distinguished name, search scope, attributes, filters, and employee mapping configuration.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new LDAPUserLookupSetting with the specified base distinguished name and default employee selector mapping.

methods.name: getBaseDN
methods.description: Returns the base distinguished name for LDAP searches.

methods.name: getSearchScope
methods.description: Returns the scope of the LDAP search (subtree or one level).

methods.name: setSearchScope
methods.description: Sets the search scope for LDAP queries, validating against allowed values.

methods.name: getUserNameAttribute
methods.description: Retrieves the LDAP attribute used as the username.

methods.name: setUserNameAttribute
methods.description: Sets the LDAP attribute used as the username.

methods.name: getUserUniqueIdAttribute
methods.description: Retrieves the LDAP attribute used as the unique identifier for users.

methods.name: setUserUniqueIdAttribute
methods.description: Sets the LDAP attribute used as the user unique ID.

methods.name: getUserSearchFilter
methods.description: Returns the LDAP search filter used when searching for users.

methods.name: setUserSearchFilter
methods.description: Sets the LDAP search filter used for user searches.

methods.name: getEmployeeSelectorMapping
methods.description: Retrieves the LDAP employee selector mapping configuration.

methods.name: setEmployeeSelectorMapping
methods.description: Sets the LDAP employee selector mapping configuration.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Serializes the settings into an associative array.

methods.name: createFromArray
methods.description: Creates a new LDAPUserLookupSetting instance from an associative array of settings.
